goal: Embed a hash-pinned SmolLM2-135M-Instruct Q4_K_M GGUF and refine queue titles locally after persist, with compact_title as the durable fallback.
outcome: Persist, composer add, and body edit always write compact_title first. A Rust llama-cpp-2 worker may refine from a vendored local file after persist. Missing file, hash mismatch, timeout, empty, or inference failure keeps compact_title. Capture ID and terminal result are never dropped. TitleABI.swift stays a compile-only stub. ADR-019 stays Proposed with this candidate. T-10 carves out offline vendored hash-pinned weights. Hosted AI, PCC, runtime Hub fetch, Needle, Qwen, and event-tap inference stay forbidden.

requirements.statement: Persist compact_title first (40-character word-boundary clamp, no ellipsis). Model refine runs after persist on a dedicated thread or spawn_blocking — not AppKit main, not the event-tap. Failure keeps compact_title. Never drop a capture ID or terminal result.
ADR-017 stays Accepted: no runtime network, telemetry, CDN, account, or Hugging Face Hub download. llama-cpp-2 loads a local file only. Never -hf. Never take a path from WebView (SEC-003).
T-10 carve-out: offline vendored hash-pinned weights are allowed. Hosted AI and Private Cloud Compute stay forbidden. Do not treat this as a general model-download permission.
First embed is HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct Q4_K_M GGUF only. If 135M titles are unusable in a spike, stop and report. Do not silently swap to 360M, Gemma, Needle, Qwen, or Llama 1B.

Inference lives in Rust. TitleABI.swift stays a compile-only stub returning BRONZE_STATUS_DEGRADED. Swift source-scan bans stay: PrivateCloudCompute, URLSession, openai, llama, gguf, SystemLanguageModel, NLEmbedding.
Event-tap callbacks must not touch AX, DB, windows, clipboard, or inference.
ADR-019 stays Proposed. Rewrite the Proposed candidate to this embed path. Never silently accept ADR-002, ADR-009, ADR-018, or ADR-019.
Do not silently add hardened-runtime JIT or unsigned-executable-memory entitlements. Prefer a CPU path that needs none. Document Metal/JIT entitlement impact.
Weights are developer/CI vendored once, SHA-256 pinned, not user-writable via the app. Record HF repo, revision, filename, SHA-256, and Apache-2.0 NOTICE/LICENSE in-tree.
No Apple Intelligence or model-status chrome unless a packet requires a locale string. Queue titles keep clip without ellipsis. No Cooper/Copper copy.
Persist always writes compact_title even if the title worker fails, the GGUF is missing, or the hash mismatches.
The title worker has no runtime network (source or unit). Capture ID and terminal result are never dropped.
TitleABI.swift still bans llama, gguf, openai, PrivateCloudCompute, URLSession, SystemLanguageModel, and NLEmbedding.
ADR-019 Proposed candidate describes SmolLM2-135M-Instruct Q4_K_M + llama-cpp-2 + vendored hash + compact_title fallback. Status stays Proposed. T-10 records the offline-vendored carve-out.
